_readme: Canonical Standard-vocabulary contract, pinned from BOTH language sides: src/lib/standard-mapping.test.ts asserts the TS tables match, and the bridge test standard_style_aliases_match_the_shared_parity_fixture in apps/iphone-native/rust/src/lib.rs asserts native_preset() maps each style id to the same engine preset. The loudness trio is mapped in Swift (NativeLoudness -> the lufs_target FFI argument), so its cross-pin lives in the TS test plus the bridge's loudness-target test. Change this file and all consumers together.
